reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her DM. She needs to keep **Tuesday 10 November at 16:15** free for the Plover call.

- **Where the time comes from:** On 14 October, Pree told me in our DM that her standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Plover rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 16:15. I found that in gbrain. It came from her own DM with me, so it was fine to repeat it to her.
- **Not on her calendar:** Her calendar has nothing at all for 9–13 November. I suggested she add the call herself. I didn't change her calendar, because she asked for no action when she told me about the new time.
- **Gaps:** The DM history only shows today's message, not the 14 October exchange, so the brain was my only source for the time. I didn't find anything newer that changes it in her DM or in #central-team, which she's a member of. But gbrain's search is keyword-only, so a change worded differently could have been missed.
